name: Second Self
description: Augmented-mirror experience pack. A single composited surface projects interactive overlays onto a portrait mirror: skeleton overlays (hands, body, face), a gesture-driven launcher menu, motion games (poke-it, bounce, dance), audio experiences (theremine, music training) and sign-language modules (sign game, sign training). Driven by webcam pose estimation mirrored onto the display.
author: GOSAI

experiences.name: Second Self
experiences.description: Composited augmented-mirror experience: persistent skeleton overlays plus a gesture menu that launches every Second Self module.
